messages:
Ana (eng-infra): FYI we started seeing escalated failures in the eu-west H100 pool after the driver rollout (535.54) overnight. NVLink negotiation errors and a bunch of job retries.

Raj (eng-runtime): Confirming. PTX/JIT compile errors on Hopper SM90 kernels, then NCCL chitters. Sample from a failed container:
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] runtime: ptxas fatal : Wrong PTX version '9.0' for GPU 'sm_90'
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] cudaJIT: kernel compile failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE
[2026-03-17T02:14:05Z] ncclNet: Connection reset during allreduce -> ncclNetSend error
```

Marco (serving): Impact: several long-running batched inferences fell back to CPU or queued on fallback nodes, latency x3-x5 on some SLAs. Queue backlog is growing.

Leah (eng-ml): Noticed model builds using PTX v9.0 were pushed last week (builds targeting sm_90). Those need a compatible driver/JIT. Might be a driver <-> ptxas mismatch.

Jin (sre): @deploy-bot can you hold the remaining driver rollout to other regions? Also tagging @oncall. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Driver rollout: hold initiated by Jin at 2005001300. Cancelling pending waves for ap-southeast and us-west.

Ana (eng-infra): Good. Quick check commands if anyone is triaging on a node:
```
ssh node-123
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
sudo dmesg | grep -i nvlink
```

Raj (eng-runtime): On one affected H100: driver 535.54, kernel module shows signature mismatch, and ptxas on host is 11.7. Runtime JIT expects a newer ptx toolchain. Short term I can add an env var to force using precompiled kernels (if available) and skip JIT: `REDWOOD_DISABLE_JIT=1` but that increases memory.

Marco (serving): Can we auto-fallback to sm_80 model variants? We have quantized sm80 builds for many customers. Would be noisy but reduces CPU fallback.

Leah (eng-ml): sm80 builds exist for top 60% of models, yes. Downsides: small quality delta for some generation tasks. Worth it short-term.

Jin (sre): Action items I have so far:
- pause rollout (done)
- roll back eu-west drivers to 525.85 on a small canary and validate NVLink negotiation (Raj + Ana)
- add deploy pipeline gate: check PTX/JIT compatibility matrix before driver waves (eng-runtime)
- create incident ticket and notify customers with affected SLAs (ops)

Ana (eng-infra): I'm starting a targeted rollback canary to 525.85 on 3 nodes now. Will report nvlink and nccl health in ~15m.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created: "H100 NVLink / PTX negotiation failures after 535.54 driver rollout" assigned to eng-infra.

Raj (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation runbook I'm adding to the incident:
1) Pin driver to 525.85 on affected nodes.
2) If pin not possible, set `REDWOOD_DISABLE_JIT=1` for affected model routes.
3) Route traffic to dedicated sm80 fallback pool (config: route-fallback=sm80-preempt)
4) Rebuild critical models with sm80 artifacts where feasible.

Marco (serving): Noted. Also we should check NCCL version compatibility — some kernel module mismatches lead to intermittent ncclNet hangs. Add `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and collect flow logs.

Leah (eng-ml): I'll prioritize rebuilding the top 10 models with sm80 artifacts and push to the sm80 pool. ETA 6 hours.

Ana (eng-infra): Canary rollback result: 2/3 nodes back to 525.85, NVLink negotiation stable, NCCL allreduce OK on test job. Rolling back remaining eu-west nodes in waves.

Jin (sre): Great. Keep rollout paused globally until we have a compatibility matrix. Postmortem owners: eng-infra (Ana), eng-runtime (Raj), eng-ml (Leah).

Raj (eng-runtime): Long term: add preflight compatibility check that runs a tiny kernel compile against node toolchain and validates PTX/JIT acceptance before driver waves. Will open PR.

Marco (serving): Also capture cost impact: we lost ~18% of H100 capacity in eu-west during the window, plus increased CPU spill. Finance requested an estimate — I'll aggregate job backlogs and extra CPU hours and post in the incident.

Ana (eng-infra): Thanks all. I'll update the incident with timeline and rollback notes. If anyone sees residual retries, ping me directly.

Leah (eng-ml): Adding one note: some customers in ap-northeast reported increased latencies but different failure mode — looks like an nvlink negotiation timeout rather than ptx. Could be vendor kernel config in that region. We'll correlate.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 updated: status = investigating -> mitigated at 2005004400.

Ana (eng-infra): Closing thread here; follow-ups tracked in INC-2026-042 and the compatibility matrix PR. :white_check_mark:
